# GET /rooms/:id/availability?date=YYYY-MM-DD

## Goal
Return the free time slots of a room for a given UTC day.

## Decisions (flag to the user, do not silently change)
- Opening hours: 08:00–20:00 UTC, as named constants `OPEN_HOUR = 8`, `CLOSE_HOUR = 20`
  in the lib module. No hours exist anywhere in the repo yet; this is an assumption.
- Intervals are half-open `[start, end[`: a booking ending at 10:00 does NOT block a slot
  starting at 10:00. Do NOT reuse `src/lib/overlap.ts` — its `overlaps()` uses `<=` and
  treats touching intervals as overlapping (contradicts its own doc). Do not fix it either
  (out of scope; it is reported to the user separately).
- Bookings spanning midnight are clipped to the day window.
- Free slots are the maximal gaps (not fixed hourly chunks). Gaps of zero length are dropped.

## Response contract
- 200: `{ "roomId": "salle-a", "date": "2026-10-05", "open": "2026-10-05T08:00:00.000Z",
  "close": "2026-10-05T20:00:00.000Z", "free": [ { "startsAt": "...Z", "endsAt": "...Z" } ] }`
  All dates ISO 8601 UTC strings (`toISOString()`).
- 404 `{ "error": "salle inconnue" }` if the room does not exist (same message as GET /rooms/:id).
- 400 `{ "error": "..." }` if `date` is missing, not matching `^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$`, or not a
  real calendar date (e.g. 2026-02-30 must be rejected — check round-trip via toISOString).

## Step 1 — pure lib module `src/lib/availability.ts`
- `parseDay(date: unknown): Result<string>` — validates the query param, returns the
  normalized `YYYY-MM-DD`. Returns `{ ok: false, error }`, never throws (repo rule: Result,
  not throw; do NOT use `src/lib/validate.ts`, which throws).
- `freeSlots(date: string, booked: { startsAt: string; endsAt: string }[]): { startsAt: string; endsAt: string }[]`
  — pure, sort + merge booked intervals clipped to the window, return the gaps.
- Define a local `Result<T>` type in this module if none exists in the repo
  (`{ ok: true; value: T } | { ok: false; error: string }`).
- Conventions: relative imports with `.js`; every exported function gets a one-line JSDoc
  (root AGENTS.md); also provide an `export default freeSlots` (src/lib/AGENTS.md requires
  a default export). Pure: no store import in this module.
- Unit tests in `test/availability.test.ts` (vitest): empty day → one slot 08–20;
  booking in the middle → two slots; touching bookings 09–10 and 10–11 → merged, no
  zero-length slot; booking touching open/close edges; booking spanning midnight clipped;
  booking on another day ignored; fully booked day → `[]`; parseDay rejects missing,
  `2026-1-5`, `2026-02-30`, `abc`; accepts `2026-10-05`.

## Step 2 — route in `src/routes/rooms.ts`
- Add `roomsRouter.get("/:id/availability", ...)`: 404 unknown room, 400 on bad date,
  else 200 with the contract above, using `bookingsForRoom(room.id)` from `store.ts`
  (read-only use; do NOT modify `src/store.ts`).
- HTTP tests in `test/availability.route.test.ts`, same `call()` helper style as
  `test/bookings.test.ts` (app.listen(0) + fetch): 200 for `salle-a` on `2026-10-05`
  (seeded booking 09:00–11:00 → free 08–09 and 11–20); 200 with full day for `labo`;
  404 for `cave`; 400 for missing date and `2026-02-30`.

## Done when
`npm run test:unit`, `npm run typecheck` and `npm run lint` are all green (there is no
`npm test` script despite AGENTS.md). No new dependency. `src/store.ts` untouched.

1	# GET /rooms/:id/availability?date=YYYY-MM-DD
2	
3	## Goal
4	Return the free time slots of a room for a given UTC day.
5	
6	## Decisions (flag to the user, do not silently change)
7	- Opening hours: 08:00–20:00 UTC, as named constants `OPEN_HOUR = 8`, `CLOSE_HOUR = 20`
8	  in the lib module. No hours exist anywhere in the repo yet; this is an assumption.
9	- Intervals are half-open `[start, end[`: a booking ending at 10:00 does NOT block a slot
10	  starting at 10:00. Do NOT reuse `src/lib/overlap.ts` — its `overlaps()` uses `<=` and
11	  treats touching intervals as overlapping (contradicts its own doc). Do not fix it either
12	  (out of scope; it is reported to the user separately).
13	- Bookings spanning midnight are clipped to the day window.
14	- Free slots are the maximal gaps (not fixed hourly chunks). Gaps of zero length are dropped.
15	
16	## Response contract
17	- 200: `{ "roomId": "salle-a", "date": "2026-10-05", "open": "2026-10-05T08:00:00.000Z",
18	  "close": "2026-10-05T20:00:00.000Z", "free": [ { "startsAt": "...Z", "endsAt": "...Z" } ] }`
19	  All dates ISO 8601 UTC strings (`toISOString()`).
20	- 404 `{ "error": "salle inconnue" }` if the room does not exist (same message as GET /rooms/:id).
21	- 400 `{ "error": "..." }` if `date` is missing, not matching `^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$`, or not a
22	  real calendar date (e.g. 2026-02-30 must be rejected — check round-trip via toISOString).
23	
24	## Step 1 — pure lib module `src/lib/availability.ts`
25	- `parseDay(date: unknown): Result<string>` — validates the query param, returns the
